confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on regional Japanese price listings and one Tottori cost-of-living comparison, so they are moderately reliable. Beer, cocktail and wine are weaker: they use Tokyo and hotel-bar examples adjusted down for a smaller city. Both accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no live booking pages or listings were checked. The FX observation comes from a search summary that cites the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not read that page directly, and a third-party feed (OFX, 0.695572 for 15 Oct 2026) is consistent with it. Yen figures were converted at roughly 160 JPY per USD.
comparable_city_reasoning: Treated as a regional Japanese prefectural capital on the Sea of Japan coast. Restaurant and coffee anchors are benchmarked to Tottori-specific cost-of-living comparisons and to regional cafe listings from cities such as Akita, Kofu, Shizuoka and Kitakyushu. Tokyo and hotel-bar prices were used only as upper reference points for drinks.
